at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp ending in Z, e.g. 2026-11-10T20:15:00.000Z. That the day exists in the month needs a "format": "date-time" check or the consumer's own. Where "$" accepts a trailing newline (Python), the consumer must reject one.

items.description: One record file changed by the operation, as whole records with their rev. `after` is the record as written to disk: its rev is the one after the rev of `before` (1 when the operation created the record), and a record is deleted by writing it with `deleted: true`, never by removing the file. `before` is the record as it was, and is absent when the operation created the record. `path` is a safe path below the workspace root: no absolute path, no `..`, none of the characters Windows forbids in names. `supersedes` lists the operations whose `after` at this path the change also replaces: the versions a `fork.resolve` merged, or a write that failed under its retry.

description: An operation of the journal: one file in _app/journal/, named <at as YYYYMMDDTHHmmssSSSZ>-<profileId>-<id>.json, written before the records it changes and never changed or removed. An undo has kind `undo` and `undoes` set to the id of the operation it undoes.
